audit_items.proof_trace: Gossip path enforces index < NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS check at L535-536, but RPC paths (DataColumnsByRoot/Range) bypass this validation—they only perform KZG verification without calling verify_data_column_sidecar, allowing out-of-range indices to enter the data availability checker.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker responds to DataColumnsByRoot RPC with sidecar.index >= 128 (NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS). The malformed column bypasses index validation in the RPC handler and may cause out-of-bounds access or logic errors in downstream column indexing operations.
